name: Samuel Vilchez Santiago

items.text: Former Rep. Daisy Morales sued Vilchez Santiago and the Florida House Democratic Campaign Committee for defamation in Orange County court, over primary mailers that portrayed her as backing Republicans. As of the latest reports the suit was unresolved, and no court has ruled on it.
items.why: This is a pending civil suit from a primary opponent over campaign mailers, with no court finding and no clear link to a criterion such as lying about his own record or self-dealing.

for_review: The Florida Politics pages (the item's source link, the lawsuit story and the Nov. 2026 win story) would not open. The two Florida National News pages I could open loaded only their headings and summaries, not the article text. I did not read the complaint, the mailers or Vilchez Santiago's full response. Search snippets say he called the suit desperate and that the complaint cites a claim the mailer made about Morales endorsing a Republican, Montilla. Montilla said Morales did not endorse him. Those points are left out of the text because I could not open a page that shows them. A check of the Orange County docket (Case No. 482026CA008697A001OX) is worth doing. A Florida Elections Commission complaint filed by Morales is also mentioned in one outlet. It is unverified and not part of this item. The search on the owner's named sites found nothing about this candidate.
